visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long light-brown hair, wearing a white crop top and black sunglasses on her head, sits in a living room on a gray couch. To her left, a Border Collie dog sits wearing a yellow hat. She speaks to the camera with expressive hand gestures and a smiling face. (2) She holds up a large, bright red rectangular insulated delivery bag featuring the brand logo 'Minghu Seafood' and QR codes. The background shows a neutral-toned wall and decorative duck plushies on the couch. (3) A sequence of close-ups shows various frozen and fresh seafood items: opened oysters, scallops in shells, lobsters, and shrimp, all laid out on white plates and wooden boards. Text labels identify each item. (4) The woman is seen grilling the seafood on an electric tabletop grill. The scene features close-ups of shrimp turning orange, fish fillets sizzling, and scallops being flipped with tongs. (5) Back on the couch, the woman eats the cooked seafood, holding up a large lobster piece and an oyster to the camera before taking bites with visible enjoyment. (6) She displays screenshots of online shopping platforms like Shopee and an official website on the screen, pointing towards them as she concludes her presentation.

The female voice maintains a high-arousal tone while describing seafood products. The BGM remains consistent with a steady beat. (4) Cartoon-style boing and pop SFX are heard during cuts. The woman's voice becomes more expressive and high-valence as she eats, accompanied by subtle chewing sounds. (5) The BGM swells slightly towards the end, while the female voice provides a clear, professional call to action with rising intonation patterns.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Showcase -> Grilling & Tasting Demo -> Promotional Offer -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for a seafood BBQ set from 'Minghu Seafood' (明湖水產) intended for the Mid-Autumn Festival (Moon Festival). It uses an energetic 'unboxing and review' style to present the variety and quality of seafood included in their delivery packages, aiming to drive sales through Shopee and their official website.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator explicitly holds a branded delivery bag, lists product names with text overlays, and shows purchasing screenshots of the brand '明湖水產'.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes high-energy social media editing tropes, including variety-show text overlays and sound effects, to maintain viewer engagement for a commercial product.
